keySentence: Love slowly made the rabbit real.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The rabbit changed. He could hop now. He was alive. Love slowly made the rabbit real.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The light faded and the rabbit looked completely different. He had real fur, real eyes, and real legs that could hop. Love slowly made the rabbit real after all those years. He jumped and ran through the garden with pure joy. He could feel the wind and the grass for the first time. The boy's love had created the most beautiful miracle.
facts.Word cards: love = 사랑 / made = 만들었다 / rabbit = 토끼 / real = 진짜의
